method: 64-bit difference hash plus mirrored comparison, flag distance <= 5; SHA256 for exact matches
limitations: Only accessible /workspace raster inventories; excludes node_modules, git, generated originals, duplicate GitHub checkout, images under 300px and files over 20MB. Cloud-only and older inaccessible inventories not checked. Similarity screening is not proof of universal uniqueness.
visual_review: All 20 generated outputs reviewed for service relevance and layout-safe subject matter.
